prompt:

[{"op":"applyStatus","target":"ally","status":"strength","stacks":2},{"op":"applyStatus","target":"self","status":"strength","stacks":1}]. Lore/mood: Oath sworn in ash.

The Court is sewn to its oaths now.. Illustrate that specific action or concept clearly in a grounded ruined medieval dark fantasy world. Rich painted material detail, dramatic readable lighting, ash, old stone, worn iron, muted earth with appropriate restrained magical color. Composition portrait 2:3, 1024x1536.
